title: HTTP 404 Error
description: The server cannot find the requested resource.

message.default: The server cannot find the requested resource.

timestamp.description:
The time that the error occurred. All dates in the JSON payloads are represented in ISO 8601 date-time format. 
All date-time fields in responses must include the timezone.

param.description: The parameter the error relates to if the error is parameter-specific. You can use this to display a message near the correct form field, for example.
